# Interpolate 1D Fourier

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

With x = \[3, -2, 7, 1, 9\], n = 5, type = 0, dt_in = 0.4, Run displays y = \[3, -2, 7, 1, 9\], interpolation_size = 5, dt_out = 0.4, error = 0.

## What this example demonstrates

With x = \[3, -2, 7, 1, 9\], n = 5, type = 0, dt_in = 0.4, Run displays y = \[3, -2, 7, 1, 9\], interpolation_size = 5, dt_out = 0.4, error = 0.
